name: magic rope
desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has a magic rope. While bearing it, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use the Entangling Rope action. The rope has AC 20, HP 90, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The rope turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points, if it is 5+ feet away from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} for 1 hour or more, or if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies. If the rope is damaged or destroyed, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can fully restore it when finishing a Short or Long Rest.
